subject: LuminaHealth renewal: stability credit and phased true-up
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@luminahealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-12T15:22:00Z
Subject: Renewal planning — price hold and stability credits?

Hi Hannah,

Hope you're well. Our contract with Redwood runs out June 30 and we need to start renewal discussions. We'll be ramping down one pilot in Q3 which will lower usage temporarily; given that, we wanted to explore options to avoid a near-term price increase and to get some form of usage protection. Specifically: 1) Can Redwood hold current unit pricing for ~90 days after renewal to avoid a spike for us while we transition? 2) Are stability/usage credits available if our volume dips below committed levels for a short period?

Sara (cc) handles procurement — she can share PO timing. Happy to set a call this week.

Thanks,

Liam O'Connor
VP Product Operations, LuminaHealth
liam.oconnor@luminahealth.com
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara.patel@luminahealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-13T09:07:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — price hold and stability credits?

Hi Liam — thanks for the heads up and the clear ask. We can definitely work with you on short-term stability while you pivot usage. High level, we usually propose three paths depending on appetite for term length and budget predictability:

1) Short-term extension (6 months): keep current rates, phased true-up after 90 days, and a small usage buffer credit to cover shortfalls.
2) Standard renewal (12 months): 10% list discount + 75k stability credits (applied as token/usage credits) + 45-day price hold.
3) Multi-year (24 months): better economics — 12% list discount + 150k stability credits + 90-day price hold + reduced true-up cadence.

I'll loop finance and legal for any paperwork. I attached a 1‑page initial_offer_summary that maps estimated cost impact for each path. Can you confirm which direction you prefer and when your PO would be issued? If you prefer, we can do a 30‑minute call tomorrow to go through numbers.

Best,

Hannah Schmitt
Director, Growth Sales — Redwood Inference
[hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai]

Attachment: initial_offer_summary.pdf
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-14T11:18:00Z
Subject: FWD: LuminaHealth renewal — guidance for offer

Internal — forwarding Lumina's ask. Quick take and ask for finance/legal: Lumina is asking both a 90‑day hold and protection for a short usage dip. They look likely to prefer a 12‑month renewal but want minimal near-term rate movement. Proposed play (to balance retention and margin):

Option A (preferred to offer): 12 months, 10% discount off list, 75,000 stability credits applied as token credits over first 90 days, 45‑day price hold. Net impact: ~6.2% ARR compression first year.
Option B (if they push for 90 days hold): 24 months, 12% discount, 150,000 credits, 90‑day hold, amortize credit over year 1 and 2. Net impact: ~4.9% ARR compression but longer commitment.
Option C (short extension): 6 months at current list, include a 25,000 buffer credit and a phased true‑up if usage drops >20%.

Questions: 1) Can finance approve stability credits of up to 150k for Lumina on a 24‑month? 2) Legal — are there any standard amendments we should preempt (price-hold clause + phased true‑up language)? 3) Sales ops — if they accept Option A, what's the quickest DocuSign path?

Thanks — I'll stand by to finalize language after your feedback.

Hannah
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara.patel@luminahealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-16T17:02:00Z
Subject: LuminaHealth renewal — formal offer (option A)

Hi Liam / Sara —

Thanks for the call earlier. Per our discussion, here is the formal offer we recommend and can move to signature quickly:

Offer (final recommendation) — Option A
- Term: 12 months (renewal start July 1, 2027)
- Pricing: 10% discount off current list for the 12‑month term
- Stability credit: 75,000 token-equivalent credits applied to your account and consumed automatically during the first 90 days post-renewal; unused credits expire after 180 days
- Price hold: 45 days of guaranteed current unit pricing after the effective date to smooth your transition
- Phased true-up: if monthly usage is >20% below the agreed baseline for any month during first 90 days, we will apply a proportional usage buffer credit (no additional invoice charge for that month up to the buffer limit)

We've attached the Renewal_Offer PDF with the legal amendment draft and a DocuSign link for electronic signature. If this aligns, sign the DocuSign and we will route to finance for PO and onboarding.

Attachments: Lumina_Renewal_Offer_20270416.pdf
DocuSign: https://docusign.com/signed?envelopeId=ABC123-LUM-3927

If you need a 90‑day price hold instead of 45, let me know — we can revisit with a small credit trade (additional 25k credits) or a slightly longer term.

Best,

Hannah Schmitt
Director, Growth Sales — Redwood Inference

If you send an updated DocuSign reflecting the 90‑day price hold (with the extra 25k credits), we'll circulate for signature immediately.
